verdict.rationale:
Shopify's UCP/MCP stack lets agents do discovery, cart-building, checkout creation, and order tracking entirely through API/CLI (shopify-ucp-docs-1,19,32), but the docs explicitly carve out cases where the API cannot complete the job: checkout can enter `requires_escalation` where 'Checkout requires buyer input or review not available via API' and the agent must hand off to the merchant's own UI via continue_url (shopify-ucp-supp-buyer-handoff), and webhook subscription setup 'is not self-serve... contact your Shopify partner manager' (shopify-ucp-supp-order-webhooks) rather than being configurable via API. complete_checkout is also gated to Token-tier trust only (shopify-ucp-supp-trust-tiers).
missing for 10: self-serve webhook subscription API, full API-driven checkout with no buyer-UI escalation path, evidence of parity for merchant-admin-level configuration tasks.
